identity.title: A3COSMOS: the dust attenuation of star-forming galaxies at z = 2.5-4.0 from the COSMOS-ALMA archive
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: Our study exploits the full ALMA archive over the COSMOS field processed by the A$^3$COSMOS team

evidence.quote: using the photometric redshifts from the COSMOS2015 catalogue

question.value: How do the IRX-beta and IRX-stellar mass relations of star-forming galaxies at z=2.5-4.0 behave, using ALMA archival continuum data in COSMOS?

evidence.quote: we update our previous studies on the IRX-$\beta$ and the IRX-$M_{\ast}$ relationship of star forming galaxies at $z=2.5-4.0$ using individual FIR flux measurements for 1512 galaxies

method.value: Select COSMOS2015 galaxies at z=2.5-4.0 with dz/(1+z)<0.2 in ALMA pointings within half primary beam, beam minor axis >0.5"; remove X-ray and IRAC AGN

evidence.quote: we only select galaxies with accurately determined photometric redshifts, $\delta_{\rm{z_{\rm{ph}}}}/(1.0+z_{\rm{ph}}) < 0.2$

method.value: Scale redshifted SED template to ALMA flux, integrate 8-1000 um; 3 sigma upper limits for non-detections

evidence.quote: We redshift this SED template to the $z_{\mathrm{ph}}$ of each galaxy and rescale it to the measured ALMA flux.

assumptions.value: Fixed z~3 SED template; +-0.2 dex systematic

evidence.quote: we find a systematic spread of $\pm0.2\,\rm{dex}$ on $L_{\rm{IR}}$

validation.value: Compared with other templates and Herschel stacks

evidence.quote: The validity of our baseline SED is, however, confirmed by stacks of far-IR fluxes from our galaxy sample.

method.value: SED fitting of COSMOS2015 photometry; beta over 1500-2500 A, median of marginalised PDF; L_UV at 1600 A

evidence.quote: we calculate $\beta$ over the wavelength range of $1500<\lambda<2500\,$Å
we assumed two sets of extinction curves of local star forming galaxies (cite: Calzetti2001) and that measured for the SMC (cite: Gordon2003)
we derive a marginalised probability distribution function of $\beta$ for each individual galaxy based on the $\chi^2$ values of each template
this relation is in excellent agreement with (cite: Mclure2018)

method.value: Kennicutt1998 SFR_UV+SFR_IR; starburst if SFR >3x Schreiber2015 MS

evidence.quote: we defined galaxies as starbursts when they have SFR three times larger than the MS at their photometric redshift

method.value: 2 arcsec aperture flux per galaxy with dirty-beam area correction, RMS-weighted stacks in bins of beta and mass

evidence.quote: We measure the ALMA flux of each galaxy within an aperture with a fixed radius of 2 arcsec.

fitting.value: Linear fit to detected stacks for IRX-Mstar

findings_qualitative.value: Massive galaxies follow M99 IRX-beta; starbursts offset ~0.5 dex higher

evidence.quote: while starbursts are generally offset by $\sim0.5\,{\rm dex}$ to larger IRX values

claims.hypothesis: Do massive z~3 galaxies follow the local IRX-beta relation?
claims.experiment: Individual detections and stacks in beta bins
claims.result: Stacks follow M99 with 0.27 dex scatter

evidence.quote: The mean stacked IRX measurements in bins of $\beta$ almost perfectly follow the local relation relation of M99

claims.hypothesis: Is IRX-Mstar steeper than previously reported?
claims.experiment: Stacks in mass bins, spec-z check
claims.result: Slope 1.64; low-mass IRX lower by >=0.5 dex

evidence.quote: exhibits a significantly steeper slope than reported in previous studies at similar redshifts
